response.original_title: [%FaQ Guide%] How do I add a Passenger to my Fred Olsen Cruise Lines?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Fred Olsen Cruise Lines, you must call Disney directly at +1-866-829-1297 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent. To add someone to an existing room on a Fred Olsen Cruise Lines, you must call Disney customer service directly or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Reach out to Fred Olsen Cruise Liness at ☎ +1-866-829-1297 (US/Canada) or ☎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK, or call your original booking agent. To add someone to a room on a Fred Olsen Cruise Lines, you must call Fred Olsen Cruise Liness Customer Service directly at ☎ +1-866-829-1297 (US/Canada) or ☎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎ +44-204-586-5316
